verify_email.title: Verify an email address
verify_email.description: Verify one email address in real time (up to about 5 seconds). Returns status ok with verification_result: valid / wrong / unknown flags, quality (good, bad, risky, unknown), result, and is_syntax_error, is_free, is_role, is_disposable and is_catch_all. Costs one email credit unless served from cache. For lists, use the batch tools.

target_country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country the email is checked against, e.g. US, GB, SG. For phones this is the country assumed for numbers without a + prefix.

verify_phone.title: Verify a phone number
verify_phone.description: Verify one phone number in real time via a live network lookup. Returns status ok with verification_result: valid / wrong / unknown flags, number type (mobile, landline, voip, toll_free...), live status (live, dead, absent_subscriber...), is_ported, the current network MCC/MNC and the operator. Costs one phone credit unless served from cache.

target_country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country the phone is checked against, e.g. US, GB, SG. For phones this is the country assumed for numbers without a + prefix.

get_credits.title: Get credit balance
get_credits.description: Get the account's remaining verification credits: email_credit and phone_credit. Check before launching a large batch.

list_batches.title: List batches
list_batches.description: List the account's batch verification files with batch_uuid, name, description, status (parsing_content, ready_for_verification, verification_ongoing, verification_done, internal_error) and created and updated times. Batches are created by uploading a TXT file, which this toolset cannot do.

from_date.description: Only batches created at or after this ISO 8601 date-time.

to_date.description: Only batches created at or before this ISO 8601 date-time.

get_batch_status.title: Get batch status
get_batch_status.description: Get a batch's current status. Once parsed it also carries found_content (valid, wrong and duplicate row counts), found_cost (total and net credit cost, cache refunds) and, when verification_done, stats with valid / wrong / unknown totals and percentages.

batch_uuid.description: UUID of the batch, from list_batches or the ApexVerify dashboard.

output.description: status plus found_content, found_cost and stats as they become available.

get_batch_details.title: Get batch details
get_batch_details.description: Get a batch's full record: name, description, status, verification parameters (type, country, targeting, cache and cleaning options), parsed content counts, cost and final stats.

batch_uuid.description: UUID of the batch, from list_batches or the ApexVerify dashboard.

output.description: The batch with its parameters, found_content, found_cost and stats.

update_batch_parameters.title: Set batch parameters
update_batch_parameters.description: Set a batch's verification parameters before launch: data type, country, targeting, cache and cleaning options. Then run prepare_batch to re-parse the file with them. Replaces the stored parameters, so pass every option you want to keep.

batch_uuid.description: UUID of the batch, from list_batches or the ApexVerify dashboard.

type.description: What the batch holds: email or phone.

prepare_batch.title: Prepare a batch
prepare_batch.description: Parse and prepare an uploaded batch with its current parameters, counting valid, wrong and duplicate rows and estimating the credit cost. Can be re-run after changing parameters. Poll get_batch_status until it reaches ready_for_verification.

batch_uuid.description: UUID of the batch, from list_batches or the ApexVerify dashboard.

launch_batch_verification.title: Launch batch verification
launch_batch_verification.description: Start verifying a batch whose status is ready_for_verification. Spends credits for every row not served from cache. Poll get_batch_status for verification_done, then fetch results with export_batch_results.

batch_uuid.description: UUID of the batch, from list_batches or the ApexVerify dashboard.

output.description: status: ok, error, not_ready_for_verification, verification_already_ongoing or verification_already_done.

delete_batch.title: Delete a batch
delete_batch.description: Permanently delete a batch and its results, before or after verification but not while it is being processed.

batch_uuid.description: UUID of the batch, from list_batches or the ApexVerify dashboard.

export_batch_results.title: Export batch results
export_batch_results.description: Export a verified batch's results as JSON: one entry per email or phone with the same fields verify_email or verify_phone return, plus optional statistics and details sections. Use once get_batch_status reports verification_done.

batch_uuid.description: UUID of the batch, from list_batches or the ApexVerify dashboard.

include_details.description: Include the uploaded data and per-row details (default true).

include_statistics.description: Include the batch statistics section (default true).

export_batch_results.notes: The XLSX export format is not offered because binary responses decode as text.

output.description: Results keyed by row, each an email or phone verification result.
